{{Top|leg}}
The '''Contruum Moonbase''' was a base built and used by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

Built on the innermost [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]] - a small silver sphere dimpled with impact craters and and encrusted with mountain ranges - the Contruum Moonbase was hidden completely underground within one of these craters.<ref name="TUF" /> Utilizing simple yet effective concealment techniques not seen since the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the entrance to the base was a simple [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] masking a [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic containment field]].<ref name="TUF" /> Any ship wishing to gain access simply had to know the location of the hidden entrance, and pass through the "ground" into the massive hollow below.<ref name="TUF" />
